speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: Good morning, I am here to ask if you would be willing to donate to the "Save the Children" Charity to assist children in need.

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: Where you from?

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: North Carolina. We have representatives all across the country!

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: So you're supposed to convince me to spend my money?!

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: Not at all. We are only asking that you assist in our Charity to help children in need.

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: Other words for spending my money, no matter how you phrase it!@

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: This is a matter of perspective. You may choose to assist or not. It is up to you as an individual to make the decision.

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: So you don't argue (any more) that you are trying to get me to spend my money?

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: I have not tried to argue with you at all. All that we ask is that you donate money to our charity. This decision is yours to make.

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: Well, simply said, no.

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: If that is your decision, then we understand and thank you for your time.

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: So we only have five more passages to spend.  What time did you start this task?

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: eh...probably about 10 minutes ago. I didn't understand it. You?

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: Given the poor internet connection, I've been at this longer, but I'm not interested in charities, unless it's for me.

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: Same. To be honest, I think this gimmick is outdated. I doubt anyone would actually fall for this. Especially since we are both given specific instructions. Sorry about the connection. For some reason, mine isn't working this morning either.

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: My connection is normal - very rural here, and it's always bad.  Bet you're on a cable?

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: I am also in a rural location. Where are you?

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: Ozark woods, county has 15k people, 150k cattle :)

speaker: A3N4PX2QVLOZGQ
text: I am from the south. We have nothing but cows, horses, sheep, and chickens. Wonderful area. Right below the mountains so we have a lot of fog and lakes around here. Your county sounds absolutely wonderful. :D

speaker: A2QJP5BZ7B523H
text: I step outside and all I hear is bugs.  No neighbors, sirens, cars, just bugs.
